movers.headline: allots **11,00,000 fresh convertible warrants at Rs 119, Rs 13.09 crore**, to nine non-promoter allottees on 25% subscription money
movers.marquee: Mavira AMC LLP (Mavira Growth Opportunities Fund) (Mayank Mamania)

movers.headline: signs definitive agreements for **Bank of America to invest up to Rs 18,268.22 crore in wholly-owned Jio Credit**, reaching **49.90% on conversion of the warrant leg**
proposes **Rs 3,544.69 crore of equity and Rs 6,895.22 crore of preference shares at Rs 85, for consideration other than cash**, to swap into **Hella Infra Market**, pending shareholders

approves a **Rs 650 crore Phase II expansion** at its existing **Silvassa** plant, adding **300 TPD of polyester yarn and 50 TPD of recycled polyester yarn**, with full capacity commissioning in **CY2028**

movers.quantum: INR 600+ cr on the company's own band; ~27.4%+ of mcap
movers.headline: wins the **765 kV TL05 package** of the WR-ER Inter-Regional Network Expansion Scheme in Chhattisgarh, which it bands **Ultra-mega, INR 600+ crore**
receives **two notices of award from Dar Al Balad, Saudi Arabia**, for boiler modifications and field advisory on the **Shoaiba fuel-conversion project**, **~INR 550 crore over ~2.5 years**

movers.quantum: Rs 126.39 cr excl GST, 24 months; ~17.0% of mcap
movers.headline: receives a **Rs 126.39 crore Letter of Intent, excluding GST**, from the **PWD Arvi Division, Wardha**, to develop a **300-bed general hospital** on an item-rate basis, for completion within **24 months**

movers.quantum: Rs 115.20 cr tender-offer buyback; ~29.1% of mcap
movers.headline: approves a **tender-offer buyback of up to 1,92,00,000 shares at Rs 60, Rs 115.20 crore**, being **24.92% of standalone capital and free reserves**

order_wins: **Texmaco Rail & Engineering** — a **Rs 77.76 crore purchase order from IVC Logistics** for three rakes of ACT1 wagons, each with one BVCM wagon _(~1.8% of mcap, the narrowest §5 pass on the tape)_.

**B.R. Goyal Infrastructure** — separately from its warrant allotment above, an **NHAI work order at Rs 39,00,22,575** for engagement as **user-fee agency at the Husnapur toll plaza, Maharashtra**, won by e-tender _(~8.6% of mcap)_.

**Slone Infosystems** — **Rs 10.07 crore including GST** for **500 i5 laptops (Rs 1.02 cr) and 5,000 i3 desktops (Rs 8.41 cr)** with three months' extended warranty, to be executed within 30 days _(~13.2% of mcap)_.

**Spice Lounge Food Works** — a live-events contract from **Xora World** with an aggregate value **in excess of Rs 21 crore** over four months, which its release also frames as anticipated revenue potential _(~1.2% of mcap)_.

**Diamond Power Infrastructure** — a **Rs 61.04 crore Letter of Intent from Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam** for 33 kV HT XLPE cable, which at **0.32% of a Rs 19,076 cr market cap fails §5** and is not surfaced as a mover.

**Viviana Power Tech** — **L1 bid confirmation, not an award**, at **Rs 113 crore inclusive of taxes** for MVCC overhead conversion and underground networking for MGVCL _(demoted per the GPT Infraprojects ruling of 06-Aug)_.

**JSW Infrastructure** — signs the **concession agreement with Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Authority, Kolkata** for the outer container terminal and berths 1-5 at Netaji Subhash Dock, following its 09-Jun LoA; **no project cost is stated**.

**Already published — SEPC.** Its results release restates the **4.2 MTPA SAIL-IISCO Burnpur pellet-plant package at Rs 952.19 crore**, published on **05-Aug at Rs 854.57 crore net of input tax credit**; the release does not reconcile the two bases.
**No value stated, so not surfaced (§3):** **Mayasheel Ventures**, **Ahasolar Technologies**, **Dhanashree Electronics** and **AVG Logistics**.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Shalimar Paints** — alongside the swap above, the same board approved **Rs 105.86 crore of preferential equity for cash at Rs 85 to non-promoter allottees** and **a QIP of up to Rs 1,000 crore**, both subject to shareholders.
**Prostarm Info Systems** — **29,43,717 fully convertible warrants at Rs 147, Rs 43.27 crore**, to non-promoter investors on a preferential basis _(~5.0% of mcap; new warrants, §4)_.

**A raise WITHDRAWN, which is the opposite of one.** **SBC Exports' board approved the withdrawal and cancellation of its proposed preferential issue of equity shares**, yet the row reached the store as a **Rs 99.06 crore `fund_raise`** _(the Garnet family, 11-Aug)_.

**Brookfield India Real Estate Trust's Rs 1,700 crore** is a **REIT** disclosure — trust capital recycling, demoted under §3 — as are **Embassy Office Parks REIT's Rs 400 crore**, **Maple Infrastructure Trust**, **Cube Highways Trust** and **Interise Trust**.

**Earlier stages, no size stated:** **Texmo Pipes** (Rs 6.98 cr preferential), **Chemiesynth (Vapi)**, **Finkurve Financial**, **63 Moons** (a raise at subsidiary Ticker Limited), **GMR Airports** and **Magellanic Cloud** (an amendment to its issue objects).
equity_allotments: **UVS Hospitality and Services** — allots **23,87,257 equity shares at Rs 100, Rs 23.87 crore, for consideration other than cash**, completing the **share-swap acquisition of 34.76% of Calcio Restaurants**, plus 2,16,000 cash shares and 4,45,000 warrants.

**Pune E-Stock Broking** — converts **7,61,000 warrants into equity, Rs 9.76 crore** _(~2.4% of mcap)_. **Fischer Medical Ventures** (Rs 11.64 cr) and **Rekvina Laboratories** (Rs 4.63 cr) filed conversions and a preferential allotment on the same day.

**Audroc** — allots **3,75,00,000 fully convertible equity warrants to a single allottee**, with **no rupee value in the intimation**, so nothing is published. **Ajooni Biotech's** 90,00,000-security allotment is held out on a content mismatch.
m_and_a: **UltraTech Cement / Waaree Energies — one deal, filed from both sides.** UltraTech subscribes **26% of Solaris Horizon Energy, a Waaree wholly-owned subsidiary, for Rs 27,75,50,000 in cash** alongside an Energy Supply Agreement, closing within 180 days _(0.01% of UltraTech's mcap)_.

**Krystal Integrated Services** — acquires **100% of Citelum India from the EDF Group** to hold it as a wholly-owned subsidiary in city and street lighting; **the release states no consideration**, so no rupee figure is published here.

**Max Estates** — subsidiary **Max Square allotted 8,75,09,608 shares on conversion of Series A and B CCDs** held by Max Estates and New York Life; **Max Estates' stake stays at ~51% with no change in control**, so the Rs 1,104.82 cr recall figure is not a consideration.

**Bluspring Enterprises** — amalgamates **Bluspring New Horizon One into STEAG Energy Services (India)**, both wholly-owned; the **Rs 537.70 crore is the transferee's FY26 turnover**, not a price, and the transaction is exempt as an intra-group deal.

**Shah Alloys** — a **strategic review and proposed restructuring or monetisation of the Santej steel plant**, whose operations the board resolved to close in July 2025 as the machinery had aged and the technology become obsolete; **no value stated**.

**No consideration or swap ratio stated:** **Coal India** (a non-binding MoU with ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel India), **SecMark Consultancy** (amalgamating Codifi Finserv), **Dixon Technologies**, **Raymond Realty**, **Lenskart**, **N2N Technologies**, **Race Eco Chain** and **Mallcom (India)**.
capex_core: **Sambhv Steel Tubes** — receives Environmental Clearance for Unit-3 at Sarora, Raipur, for a **30 MW CAPTIVE power plant at a proposed INR 1,500 million**; **§6 skips captive power** as a cost item rather than core capacity, so it is not a mover.

**Juniper Green Energy** — **commissions an additional 167 MW of wind capacity**, with no project cost stated. **JK Cement** commissions its **J.K. White Nathdwara wall-putty plant**, likewise unvalued.

**Ice Make Refrigeration's Rs 39.00 crore** is an **object of a proposed issue** — *'potential acquisition of new business'* in an EGM corrigendum, alongside Rs 35.28 crore for a JV subscription — not an announced transaction.

**No material rupee commitment stated:** **Multi Commodity Exchange** (a proposed mineral spot exchange), **Mukta Arts**, **Tinna Rubber** (a Saudi wholly-owned subsidiary), **Natural Capsules**, **Prostarm** (an MoA alteration) and **Kay Power and Paper**.
business_updates: **Ola Electric** — the Ministry of Heavy Industries revises the **ACC PLI timelines for Ola Cell Technologies**, securing a **five-year window to CY2031 and unlocking up to Rs 7,240 crore of cumulative incentives**, disbursed quarterly _(~39% of mcap)_. The figure is a ceiling contingent on reaching the 20 GWh allocation, not money received.

**Results season, and it is most of the day** — **540 companies filed results, transcripts or presentations**. Per §2 their figures are revenue and profit, not events: **VA Tech Wabag** (Rs 886.8 cr consolidated revenue, PAT Rs 90.1 cr, **order book ~Rs 19,400 cr**), **SEPC** (Rs 282 cr income, a Rs 11 cr net loss) and **Vibhor Steel Tubes** (Rs 293.69 cr).
**Lenskart** — its shareholders' letter reports **same-store sales growth of 18.3%**, self-reported and surfaced by the tier-1 operating gate rather than the RSS subject.

**No commercial terms:** **Thomas Cook (India)** (an India Forex Report launch), **Computer Age Management Services** (an IIT Madras FinTech initiative), **Signet Industries** and **Cineline India** (a three-screen multiplex at Gurugram).
distress_risk: **Elpro International** — files the **Post Offer Public Announcement declaring its voluntary BSE delisting offer successful**, by acquirers I G E (India) and Zenox Technology Services with Surbhit and Yamini Dabriwala as persons acting in concert.

**Nova Iron & Steel** — the **Section 7 IBC application filed against the company was dismissed**, the one clearly favourable insolvency outcome on the tape. **HCL Infosystems** reports a **favourable CESTAT Allahabad order**.

**Associated Alcohols & Breweries** — the **Madhya Pradesh High Court stays an FSSAI order**; **Matrimony.com** reports a Madras High Court order in a trademark suit brought by Free Elective Network; **neither quantifies the impact**.

**Show-cause notices and CoC business, none quantified:** **Ucal** (GST audit), **ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems**, **SKIL Infrastructure** (ninth CoC meeting), **Reliance Communications** (CoC on 13-Aug), **McNally Bharat**, **Unitech International** and **Birla Corporation**.
other_notable: **Ambalal Sarabhai Enterprises — the store's Rs 81.99 crore 'JV' is Rs 81.99 LAKH**, the one-time **New Labour Codes provision** booked as an exceptional item in its results; the row carried it as a jv_agreement at 23.29% of market cap.

**Switching Technologies Gunther** — a **Rs 50 crore buyback figure at 181.8% of a Rs 27.50 crore market cap** sits on a row the store itself flags as a content mismatch; **the cached filing does not support it**, so no figure is published.

**Credit-rating actions are theme-only and never movers (§3), and these are facility sizes rather than events:** **Vikram Solar Rs 4,000 crore**, **Huhtamaki India Rs 200 crore** and **Jay Ushin Rs 63.49 crore**. None states a notch change in the intimation.

**Splits are never movers (§6):** **Bansal Wire Industries** alters its capital clause for a sub-division and **TD Power Systems** fixes the record date for its stock split. **Paisalo Digital** held an FCCB committee meeting.
**Shareholding and SAST disclosures (names only, §1):** 28 rows, including Vedanta, Mahindra & Mahindra, Emami, Inox Wind and Star Health. The detail is deliberately not carried.

tally: 2026-08-12: 2,968 announcements captured (00:00–23:59 IST) on a Wednesday results-season tape — **540 companies filed results material** — with 1,275 material rows → **8 verified movers**. The day's defining transaction is **Bank of America's up-to Rs 18,268.22 cr investment in Jio Credit**, 26.50% in equity now and 49.90% after warrants, and **the baseline stored no amount for it at all**. The most consequential for its own size is **Shalimar Paints proposing Rs 3,544.69 cr of equity and Rs 6,895.22 cr of CCPS, both for consideration other than cash, to swap into Hella Infra Market** — a reverse acquisition several times its Rs 702 cr market value, typed a fund raise and published on one leg. Below them the tape is orders and capacity: **Raj Rayon's Rs 650 cr Silvassa Phase II**, **Bajel's Ultra-mega TL05 765 kV package at INR 600+ cr**, **GE Power India's ~Rs 550 cr Saudi fuel-conversion award** and **Vascon's Rs 126.39 cr Wardha hospital**, against one capital return in **Shardul Securities' Rs 115.20 cr tender-offer buyback**. **One marquee row, and it is real** — Mavira AMC LLP (Mayank Mamania) among nine non-promoter allottees of B.R. Goyal's fresh warrants, the first genuine star since the always-surface change. Eight baseline movers failed: **Yes Bank's Rs 8,500 cr is debt authorised at an AGM a year ago**, **SEPC's Rs 10,670 cr and Wabag's Rs 19,400 cr are order books**, **A.K. Capital's Rs 3,000 cr is a Section 186 limit**, **SBC Exports' Rs 99.06 cr raise was withdrawn** — and **Ambalal Sarabhai's Rs 81.99 crore is Rs 81.99 lakh**, a labour-code provision in a Rs-in-lakhs results table.
